answer: Periodic roll-calls give each identity a fresh, context-bound prompt only a live model can answer distinctly; peers cross-check reasoning traces and timing. Cloned keys cannot replay replies, and scripted pools fail as prompts vary. Attackers move from the nadir of cheap copying to the summit of running many live models, paying continuous inference and latency. The shared challenge seed is a lotus: it opens differently for each honest responder, so cached answers wilt.
